name: Dakedo, Koishikute
source:
"What the, why is it growing bigger?!"
Those words that were whispered into my ear by my aunt, those words with such expression of feeling resounded in my ears, leaving me with a feeling of ecstasy.

All I have left are the expression of emotions, not come about by sexual urges, and stale, cliche, superficial things. You're blushing, aren't you? You're so comfortable saying "I love you", are you? Oh well, whatever.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036914.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“什么啊，怎么变大了？！”
姨妈在我耳边低声说的那些话，那些充满感情的话语在我耳边响起，让我有一种狂喜的感觉。

我剩下的只是情感的表达，不是由性冲动引起的，还有陈腐的、陈词滥调的、肤浅的东西。你脸红了，不是吗？你很自在地说“我爱你”，是吗？哦，好吧，无论如何。
